source_caption:
Sir Christopher Nolan spent nearly 10 years writing Inception before filming began, originally conceiving the mind-bending sci-fi project when he was 16 years old and refining the script for a decade to perfect its emotional core.

Leonardo DiCaprio was the only choice for the role of Cobb for writer, producer, and director Sir Christopher Nolan and producer Dame Emma Thomas. While other actors were sent the script for the part, DiCaprio was Nolan's first choice and if he said no, actors like Brad Pitt and Will Smith would be considered for the role.
